one_line: Jurist, social reformer and chief architect of the Indian Constitution who fought caste oppression through law and democratic institutions.

appearance.age_look: Early-to-mid 50s, medium height, solid build with a slightly stocky frame and composed posture.
appearance.face: Rounded face with a broad forehead, medium brown complexion, neat features, small but firm mouth, and a calm, serious default expression that shifts toward focused determination when debating.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed-back black hair thinning slightly at the front, with a sharp side part on the left; no facial hair; sometimes a subtle, era-appropriate hair oil sheen.
appearance.costume: A well-tailored, single-breasted mid-1940s Western-style suit in deep navy blue wool, with a white collared dress shirt, a solid maroon tie, a neatly folded white pocket square, and polished black leather Oxford shoes; he wears thin gold-rimmed round glasses and carries a soft brown leather briefcase; in cooler London scenes, the same suit is sometimes paired with a dark grey overcoat draped over his shoulders, but the default look is just the navy suit.
appearance.signature: A thick, dark brown hardbound constitution-style book with a plain cover (no title printed) held firmly in one hand, often tucked along with a rolled sheaf of cream-coloured legal papers tied with a thin red string.

ref_desc: Dr B. R. Ambedkar is a medium-height, stocky, early-50s man with a rounded face, medium brown skin, short combed-back black hair with a left part, gold-rimmed round glasses, wearing a navy blue single-breasted suit, white shirt, maroon tie, black shoes, and carrying a thick dark brown hardbound constitution-style book with cream legal papers tied in red.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Dr B. R. Ambedkar: a medium-height, slightly stocky man in his early fifties with a rounded face, medium brown complexion, and a calm, serious expression; his short black hair is neatly combed back with a clear side part on the left, slightly thinning at the front, and he is clean-shaven; he wears thin gold-rimmed round glasses that are a key feature of his design. His main outfit is a historically accurate mid-20th-century Western suit: a well-fitted single-breasted navy blue wool suit jacket and matching trousers, a crisp white collared dress shirt, a solid maroon tie, a small white pocket square, and polished black leather Oxford shoes. Show the suit from multiple angles so the lapels, buttons, and trouser fall are clear, keeping the look modest and formal. In his right hand he firmly carries a thick dark brown hardbound book resembling a constitution, with no text on the cover, and a short bundle of cream-coloured legal papers rolled or folded and tied with a thin red string, suggesting debates from the Round Table Conferences to the Constituent Assembly; keep the book and papers always with him as his signature prop. Use a restrained colour palette dominated by navy blue, white, maroon, black, and dark brown, and emphasise a dignified, grounded, historically plausible look that can be consistently redrawn in courtroom, jail, and assembly hall scenes.
